summary: Full backend + frontend testing pass for GroovLabz. 16/16 pytest backend tests pass (health, auth register/login/me/wrong-pass, shop products list + by-id + 404, checkout create session + status + empty/unknown 400, contact, activity log+list, dashboard, orders, auth guard). Frontend: home hero + 5 app cards, apps page + DownloadModal (Google Play/App Store), all 5 instrument tabs functional (piano key toggles active class, drum pad, guitar string clickable), shop products list + Add-to-cart auto-opens cart drawer with correct badge=1 and subtotal, checkout button fires POST /api/payments/checkout (page navigates to Stripe so body read errored but backend endpoint verified separately), admin login redirects to /account showing Orders/Total Spent/Apps Connected stats, connect-app POST /api/activity returns 200, contact form POST /api/contact returns 200, /about /privacy /terms all 200, register creates account and redirects to /account.

issues: GET /api/auth/me is called on load with no token producing 401 console errors on every page — expected but should be suppressed (skip call when no gl_token in localStorage) to keep console clean

action_items: (Nice-to-have) In frontend auth bootstrap, skip GET /api/auth/me if no gl_token is present, to avoid noisy 401 in console on public pages.
(Nice-to-have) DownloadModal does not close on Escape key — only backdrop/close-button click. Consider wiring Escape key handler.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py uses deprecated FastAPI @app.on_event('startup'/'shutdown') — should migrate to lifespan handlers (non-blocking).
Auth cookie is set with SameSite=None; Secure — correct for cross-site preview URL. Good.
get_current_user correctly excludes password_hash and _id — good.
No brute-force lockout implemented on /api/auth/login (playbook mentions 5-fail lockout). Not blocking for MVP but worth noting.
SHOP_PRODUCTS is in-memory constant — acceptable for MVP but should move to DB for admin-editable catalog.
server.py is 550 lines — approaching the split threshold; consider splitting into routers/ modules (auth.py, shop.py, payments.py, contact.py, activity.py) as the app grows.

CORS_ORIGINS='*' with allow_credentials=True is technically invalid per CORS spec (browsers reject credentials with wildcard). Works in this preview but should be an explicit origin list for production.
test_credentials: admin@groovlabz.com / admin123 (seeded on startup, verified working)
seed_data_creation: Seeded admin verified via login. Test users created dynamically per pytest run via /api/auth/register.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All acceptance criteria verified. Cart drawer auto-opens on add-to-cart (no need to click open-cart-button after add). Checkout button triggers Stripe redirect immediately, so if measuring the API response in Playwright, use page.expect_response and read status only (not body — page may navigate before body read). Backend brute-force lockout is not implemented — playbook item to consider for future hardening.
